gene_universe: Stage 4 GENCODE v36 protein_coding label table

cnv_thresholds.baseline: per-case mode across observed autosomal protein-coding genes, higher mode on ties
cnv_thresholds.deletion: copy number < baseline, including zero; this is loss rather than exclusively homozygous deletion
cnv_thresholds.sex_chromosomes: unavailable until sex-aware baseline validated; retain missing flag

deferred_features.hic_promoter_local: Requires a validated .hic extraction route and an acquired independent GSE185069 build declaration.
deferred_features.hic_promoter_distal: Requires a validated .hic extraction route and an acquired independent GSE185069 build declaration.
deferred_features.pancreas_crispr_dependency: Validation-only feature; excluded from training data to preserve orthogonal validation.
